name: Ama Ero! ~Osananajimi to Ama Ama Ecchi~
original_name: 甘エロ!～幼馴染みと甘々エッチ～
source:
You and your childhood friend have feelings for on another.
But you are unable to express them with words.
Your birthday draws near and...
